title: `--security-opt unmask` cannot unmask `/sys/devices/virtual/powercap`, because it is re-added to maskedPaths after unmask is applied
body:
### Issue Description

I am running rootless-podman-in-rootless-podman with SELinux enabled on Fedora 44.

Rest of the text is generated by Claude (opus 5.5) that diagnosed this problem.

For an unprivileged container, podman puts `/sys/devices/virtual/powercap` into the OCI `linux.maskedPaths` twice: once from the default masked-paths list, and again from `addMaskedPaths` in `libpod/container_internal_linux.go` ([v5.8.0, L804-L808](https://github.com/containers/podman/blob/v5.8.0/libpod/container_internal_linux.go#L804-L808)), which appends it whenever the masked list is non-empty. `--security-opt unmask=...` is applied before that append, so it removes only the first copy. Passing the path twice in `unmask` does not help, and even `unmask=ALL` leaves it masked. The only ways to get rid of it are `--privileged` or an empty masked-paths list, both of which drop all the other masks too.

So the documented `unmask` option silently does not work for this one path.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

```sh
id=$(podman create --security-opt unmask=/sys/devices/virtual/powercap registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44 true)
podman init "$id" >/dev/null
jq -c '.linux.maskedPaths' "$(podman inspect -f '{{.StaticDir}}' "$id")/config.json"
podman rm -f "$id"
```

Run the same without the `--security-opt` flag for comparison.


### Describe the results you received

Default (powercap appears twice):

```
["/sys/kernel","/proc/acpi","/proc/kcore","/proc/keys","/proc/latency_stats","/proc/sched_debug","/proc/scsi","/proc/timer_list","/proc/timer_stats","/sys/devices/virtual/powercap","/sys/firmware","/sys/fs/selinux","/proc/interrupts","/sys/devices/virtual/powercap"]
```

With `unmask=/sys/devices/virtual/powercap` (one copy is still there):

```
["/sys/kernel","/proc/acpi","/proc/kcore","/proc/keys","/proc/latency_stats","/proc/sched_debug","/proc/scsi","/proc/timer_list","/proc/timer_stats","/sys/firmware","/sys/fs/selinux","/proc/interrupts","/sys/devices/virtual/powercap"]
```

With `unmask=ALL`: `["/sys/kernel","/sys/devices/virtual/powercap"]`.

Inside the running container, `/sys/devices/virtual/powercap` shows up twice in `/proc/self/mountinfo` by default.

### Describe the results you expected

`unmask=/sys/devices/virtual/powercap` (and `unmask=ALL`) removes the path from `maskedPaths`, like for every other default masked path. Masking it once by default is fine. The fix is probably to drop the duplicate append, now that the path is in the default list, or to apply `unmask` after it.

### Additional information

We hit this running rootless podman inside a rootless container under the `container_engine_t` SELinux type. The inner crun has to mount its own masks on top of the outer container's masks, and the outer masks of a rootless container are labelled `user_tmp_t`, which policy denies as a mountpoint. Unmasking the affected paths in the outer container would avoid that, but it fails only for powercap:

```
Error: crun: mount `tmpfs` to `sys/devices/virtual/powercap`: Permission denied: OCI permission denied
avc: denied { mounton } ... path=".../merged/sys/devices/virtual/powercap" dev="tmpfs" scontext=system_u:system_r:container_engine_t:s0:c507,c949 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:user_tmp_t:s0 tclass=dir
```
